snippet.title: How to get your physical annual report for free? | Parth Verma
snippet.description:
Link to the description: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nXAuS70NZtktMKqKNMX8aJqgGj3HsIym_jMWq_gkbOc/edit?usp=drivesdk

Watch till the end to get your physical annual report for free.

Did you know that if you own even one share of a listed company, you can request a physical copy of its annual report?

It is one of the simplest ways to get your hands on the actual document investors and analysts use to understand a company.

In this reel, I’ve shown the complete process, what details you need, and where you can send the request.

And if you’re a finance student, investor, or someone learning equity research, this is one habit worth building.

[#AnnualReport #EquityResearch #StockMarketIndia #InvestingIndia #FinanceStudents]
